en: A colorized street scene showing a broad sidewalk running alongside a large, two‑story colonial-style building with arcaded verandas and columns. People in early 20th‑century clothing stand and walk along the sidewalk. On the left side of the image runs a street with tram tracks, power poles, and a horse‑drawn or early motor vehicle in the distance. Trees and low fencing line the street. A sign reading "WELCOME YMCA" stands near the tracks. Printed captions in Spanish at the top and in English at the bottom identify the location as Eleventh & Front Street, looking north, in Colón, Republic of Panama.
